title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Nagarbhavi

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office for sale in Nagarbhavi? SAMAN Portable manufactures ready-to-use container offices and delivers them across Nagarbhavi and the wider Bengaluru region from our own factory at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099. As a direct manufacturer, we build each unit to order on an MS steel frame, finish it at the factory, and hand it over ready for work, so you deal with the people who actually make the cabin, not a reseller.

Container Offices for Sale in Nagarbhavi

A container office in Nagarbhavi from SAMAN Portable is a factory-built steel cabin fitted with a door, windows, wiring points, flooring and wall panels, delivered ready to place and use. We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft units for site offices, sales offices, security posts and back-office space, built to order and dispatched from our Bengaluru factory for fast setup on your plot.

Container office sizes we supply

We supply three standard footprints, each built on a welded MS steel frame and finished at the factory. Sizes can be combined or customised with extra windows, partitions, washrooms or air-conditioning provision.

Size Typical use Indicative layout
10ft Security cabin, single-person site office, kiosk One compact room
20ft Site office, sales office, supervisor cabin One room or room plus small store/toilet
40ft Team office, multi-cabin layout, back office Two to three zones with partitions

Need an exact specification or a current quote? Reach out and we will scope the right size for your Nagarbhavi requirement.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Buying from the manufacturer means no middle margin and full control over the build. Every container office is made to a clear standard:

  • MS steel frame to IS 2062: the structure uses mild-steel sections to IS 2062, giving a rigid, weather-resistant cabin that travels and stacks well.
  • Factory-built at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099: fabrication, panelling, wiring points and finishing are all done in-house before dispatch.
  • ISO 9001:2015: SAMAN POS India Private Limited runs an ISO 9001:2015 quality-managed process.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.
  • Delivery and returns: delivery from ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days; returns accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

For the full range, sizes and to request pricing, see our container office collection.

Delivery and installation in Nagarbhavi

Because our factory is within Bengaluru, we deliver container offices to Nagarbhavi and neighbouring areas without long-distance haulage. Once your unit is built, it is loaded, transported and craned or skidded into position on your site. Typical transit is 3–5 days after the unit is ready, with delivery from ₹3,000 depending on size and access.

A 10ft or 20ft unit usually arrives complete and is ready to use within hours of placement. For 40ft or multi-cabin layouts, our team handles positioning and connects the units on site. We only need a reasonably level, accessible spot with room for the delivery vehicle.

Get a container office quote in Nagarbhavi

Tell us the size, layout and where in Nagarbhavi you need it, and we will share a current price and lead time. Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry on our website, and the factory team will help you choose the right unit. We confirm pricing on enquiry because every order is built to specification.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy in Nagarbhavi?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices. The 10ft suits a security or single-person cabin, the 20ft works as a standard site or sales office, and the 40ft suits teams or partitioned layouts. Units can be combined or customised.


How long does delivery to Nagarbhavi take?

Once your unit is built, transit is usually 3–5 days. Because we manufacture inside Bengaluru, delivery to Nagarbhavi is quick, and a single 10ft or 20ft cabin is typically ready to use within hours of placement. Delivery starts from ₹3,000 depending on size and access.


Can I customise my container office?

Yes. As the manufacturer we build to order, so you can add windows, internal partitions, a washroom, extra wiring points or air-conditioning provision. Tell us your layout and we will quote the customised unit.


What warranty comes with a SAMAN container office?

Each unit carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


How do I order and get a price?

Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your size, layout and Nagarbhavi location. We share a current quote and lead time, then build and deliver from our Bengaluru factory. Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

author.description: Aman Dubey is the lead marketing and copywriting expert at Saman Portable, specializing in prefabricated, shipping-container, and modular structures. With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
